_comment: The Go service (backend-go), listening on 127.0.0.1:8090. Separate upstream from teezer-laravel because it is a different process with a different health endpoint - Laravel answers /up, Fiber answers /health. Only routes explicitly pointed here reach Go; everything else still goes to the monolith. Health check is active from the start so a crashed Go service takes its routes out of rotation rather than 502-ing users.
